research.title: Occlusion-Aware Confidence Estimation for Image Classification
bullets: Formulated whether localized occlusions cause systematic overconfidence, separating prediction errors associated with foreground obstruction from those associated with background changes.
Led development of a visibility-conditioned confidence estimator and evaluated calibration against temperature scaling using controlled image masking and held-out corruption settings.

research.title: Exposure-Consistent Features for Low-Light Object Detection
bullets: Investigated whether feature consistency across simulated exposure changes improves object detection robustness without suppressing information needed to localize small objects.
Led development of an exposure-weighted consistency objective and compared detector variants through brightness-stratified evaluation and ablations of feature alignment locations.

research.title: Boundary Uncertainty in Weakly Supervised Semantic Segmentation
bullets: Formulated how uncertain object boundaries affect segmentation learned from sparse annotations, distinguishing ambiguity in pseudo-labels from errors within object interiors.
Led development of boundary-weighted pseudo-label refinement, comparing uncertainty estimates and conducting annotation-density ablations alongside evaluation on visually ambiguous scene boundaries.

publications.title: Evaluating Boundary Uncertainty Across Sparse Annotation Settings for Semantic Segmentation
Boundary-Weighted Pseudo-Label Refinement for Weakly Supervised Semantic Segmentation

work.title: Image Ingestion and Validation Utilities
bullets: Implemented assigned Python utilities for validating uploaded images, checking file integrity, dimensions, and supported formats before downstream processing.
Added regression tests for malformed inputs and maintained error-handling routines, documenting reproducible failures and coordinating fixes within the existing ingestion workflow.

projects.title: Comparative Evaluation of Image Retrieval Representations
bullets: Implemented image retrieval pipelines using color histograms and pretrained convolutional features, keeping preprocessing and similarity calculations consistent across comparison settings.
Compared retrieval rankings under cropping, color shifts, and background clutter, examining failure cases where global appearance conflicted with object identity.

projects.title: Optical Flow Estimation Under Challenging Motion
bullets: Implemented local gradient-based and coarse-to-fine optical flow baselines, using shared image pyramids and consistent handling of image borders.
Compared motion estimates on synthetic translations and image sequences, analyzing sensitivity to displacement, texture scarcity, and violations of brightness constancy.

projects.title: Class Imbalance Strategies for Visual Defect Classification
bullets: Implemented weighted cross-entropy, focal loss, and balanced sampling within a shared image classification pipeline for comparing approaches to imbalanced defect recognition.
Evaluated classwise precision and recall under fixed data splits, inspecting confusion patterns and sensitivity to decision thresholds across training configurations.
